buttons.sectionPlaneTooltip: Section plane: hover over the model and click a face to cut there
buttons.flipTooltip: Cut away the other side of the section plane
buttons.resetSectionTooltip: Reset section box to model bounds / pick a new plane

hints.sectionPlanePick: Click a face to cut through it — Esc to cancel

perpendicular.label: Perpendicular
perpendicular.description: Between point, edge and face — perpendicular to edge or face
perpendicular.hint: Pick a point, edge or face to measure from
perpendicular.hintSecond: Pick the second point, edge or face — measured perpendicular

point.label: Coordinate
point.description: X, Y and Z of a point
point.hint: Click a point to show its coordinates

area.label: Face
area.hint: Click a face to measure its area

polygon.label: Custom
polygon.description: Area between corner points you pick
polygon.hint: Click corner points ({{n}} picked) — click the first point, double-click or Enter to close, Backspace = undo point

areaTotal.label: Whole object
areaTotal.description: Area of all faces of an object
areaTotal.hint: Click an object for the total area of all its faces

volume.label: Object
volume.hint: Click an object to measure its volume

weight.label: Object
weight.description: Weight from the file or volume × density
weight.hint: Click an object to calculate its weight

angle.label: Edges and faces
angle.description: Angle between faces, edges or an edge and a face
angle.hint: Pick the edge or face the angle starts from
angle.hintSecond: Pick the second edge or face

count.label: Objects
count.hint: Click objects to count them — click again to remove

countEntity.label: Points, edges, faces
countEntity.description: Count individual points, edges and faces
countEntity.hint: Click points, edges or faces to count them — click again to remove

measure.multiTooltip: Multiple selection: measurements stay and are added up at the top. Off: a new measurement replaces the previous one.
measure.saveTooltip: Save the current measurements to the takeoff

materials.title: Materials and densities
materials.intro: The weight is taken from the file when it is stated there (e.g. IFC NetWeight). Otherwise: volume × material density. Recognised materials get a preset automatically; change it here or enter your own value.
materials.none: No materials found in the opened files.
